The prior QA view-shim journal records the QA shim (CREATE VIEW clarity.* / zod.* → per-worktree DBs) and its teardown. Jira status is QA Complete. This prep does not reopen it.

synthesis: The 500 this ticket names was ScanStatsBatchQuery addressing literal clarity.scan_report_hourly. That port already landed on main inside the Company Metrics paired-count commit (`93f9a249`), with a unit guard. The Company Metrics grid query classes already follow HitStatsBatchQuery. The three classes the ticket names as possible stragglers serve the LPR visit endpoint and the RDN metrics publisher, not /app. Ultra-Plan is a no-product-PHP close: keep the existing monthly-total tests, ticket the off-path qualifiers out, and do not add a view shim or a new helper.
